verdict.rationale: Browserbase provides webhooks for event-driven failure notifications, session replay/live view/rich logs for observability, and agents explicitly described as alerting 'the moment something breaks,' which covers monitoring and alerting well. However there is no explicit data-quality validation tooling (schema checks, data assertions) surfaced in the evidence, so the 'validate data quality' part of the story is only weakly implied via file/download processing. Missing for 10: dedicated data-quality validation features, job performance dashboards/metrics beyond logs and replay, independent confirmation of alerting reliability.
